day_line: A climbing vine on a Rabbit day. Soft and flexible: good for gentle starts and team spirit, easy to dodge hard calls.

lines.Yang Wood: A colleague eyes your project today. Divide it clearly before lunch.
lines.Yin Wood: Monday feels friendly today. Eat lunch with the team, not at your desk.
lines.Yang Fire: A mentor's tip helps today. Ask the question you think is too basic.
lines.Yin Fire: A quiet clue shows up today. Read the email twice; the answer's in it.
lines.Yang Earth: Your steady week starts well. Your boss notices; send the plan early.
lines.Yin Earth: Monday piles up quickly. Do one hour of deep work before the chat wakes.
lines.Yang Metal: Careful money suits you today. Pack lunch and log the year-end claims.
lines.Yin Metal: A side chance opens today. Reply to the recruiter, just to hear them out.
lines.Yang Water: Your pitch flows today. Say it in the huddle; three sentences max.
lines.Yin Water: Monday has a sweet spot for you. Plan something fun for Friday night.
